scope: Only transfer mechanisms potentially useful to BCEG / Certificate Discovery / P-vs-NP research. Mining, Stratum, wallet, nonce and pool behavior are explicitly out of scope.

transfer_candidates.formula_role: Rank certificate languages, boundary variables, projections or composition candidates by paid empirical utility plus uncertainty while preserving exact-complete fallback.
transfer_candidates.warning: Bandit ranking may reorder work but may not prune frozen proof scope.

transfer_candidates.formula_role: Capability/effort tiers for certificate discovery; escalation should occur only between frozen epochs after measured failure, never by changing current proof semantics.
Compact recent action/evidence trace for Pippi/M2R replay and plateau detection.
Persist successful and failed certificate-language / projection recipes and rank future discovery without converting historical success into truth.

transfer_candidates.source: JanusProofMind registry split raw_accepted / registry / inferred / meta_rules
transfer_candidates.formula_role: Separate exact proof receipts from inferred heuristics and meta-rules. Directly compatible with JANUS exact Proof DAG vs Spider associative graph separation.
Package only canonical, replayable, verifier-reconstructable proof objects; reject candidates whose claimed result cannot be reconstructed by the verifier.
Invalidate candidates produced against stale frontier/capability state before promotion or reuse.
Regulate batch/work allocation, cooldown and deprioritization under resource pressure while retaining a complete fallback lane.
transfer_candidates.warning: Mining-era strategy pruning cannot be copied literally into proof search unless completeness is preserved.

transfer_candidates.formula_role: Maintain protected competing discovery lanes so one historically strong language cannot starve alternative certificate languages.
transfer_candidates.warning: The source DualLock is weighted lane scheduling, not an independent mathematical proof verifier.

transfer_candidates.formula_role: Evaluate proposed allocation/ranking in shadow mode before it is permitted to alter proof search; collect fresh evidence separately from authority.
Guarantee minimum exploration exposure to challenger certificate languages so the search does not self-confirm a single incumbent representation.
After a recipe is exact-replayable and frozen, concentrate a bounded share of discovery work on its exact structural context while retaining challenger exposure.
transfer_candidates.warning: Historical recipe focus risks overfitting and cannot establish arbitrary-CNF complexity claims.

direct_BCEG_hypothesis.name: SHADOWED_ANTI_DISPERSION_CERTIFICATE_DISCOVERY
direct_BCEG_hypothesis.idea: Use uncertainty-aware ranking to propose certificate languages / boundary candidates; test allocation in shadow mode; promote only next-epoch after TruthGate replay; preserve protected challenger exposure; persist exact successes/failures in ProofMind/M2R; never allow advisory ranking to prune complete fallback.
direct_BCEG_hypothesis.target: Reduce certificate-discovery cost and search dispersion around the current 2^k boundary-message frontier without hiding exponential work.
not_established: No source mechanism provides a compact exact representation of arbitrary 2^k boundary assignments.
No source mechanism proves k=O(log n) for arbitrary CNF.
No source mechanism proves polynomial SAT or P=NP.

next_test: Build a mining-free CDE scheduler using these governance/ranking mechanics, then compare against frozen BCEG v2 on blind mixed-language boundaries with k>1. Measure discovery cost, exact boundary-message size, challenger exposure, replay success and total work. Keep P vs NP OPEN unless a universal proof is obtained.
